content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Government engineering and mission support contractor; not installing or maintaining commercial building MEP systems for owners."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Installs and maintains fire, mechanical, plumbing and electrical building systems for commercial owners and developers, similar to the target."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Outsourced HR, payroll and workers' compensation business; does not install or service building systems."},{"label":"C4","good":true,"reason":"Designs, installs and maintains HVAC, plumbing, electrical and controls for commercial buildings, closely matching the target's services and customers."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Concrete pumping service for contractors; does not work on building mechanical, electrical or plumbing systems."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Builds and maintains telecom and utility networks for carriers; different customers and work from building systems."},{"label":"C7","good":true,"reason":"Designs, installs and maintains electrical and low-voltage building systems for commercial and data center customers, overlapping the target's services."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Engineering, consulting and government program services; primarily design and advisory rather than installing building systems."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Owns and leases office buildings for rent; a real estate landlord, not a building systems service provider."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Water, environmental and infrastructure consulting for government clients; not building MEP installation or maintenance."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Manages REITs for management fees; asset and property management advisory rather than building systems services."}]}
